subject: Spatial glmmTMB does not converge error solutions

messages.author: cb7c94f1b8016c2d
messages.subject: Spatial glmmTMB does not converge error solutions
parts:
Hello, 

I am new to glmmTMB and experiencing convergence issues using a spatial glmmTMB model, despite a lack of such errors with an aspatial model. I have emulated the recommendations at: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/glmmTMB/vignettes/troubleshooting.html, to no avail. My data are count data at 576 locations and I'm modeling with only one variable; this should not be an issue of overparameterization. 

I am attaching a subset of my data. In addition, here is a sample of the code I have used: 
library(sp)
library(MASS)
library(car)
library(ape)
library(sjstats)
library(spaMM)
library(spdep)
library(matlib)
library(glmmTMB)

data <- read.csv("data_file.csv", header=TRUE) ##File saved to online repository

#----------Aspatial zero-inflated glmmTMB() model---------------
asp <- glmmTMB(Tot_Lar ~ 1 + NEAR_DIST, data = data, family = nbinom2(link="log"), ziformula= ~1)

#Check model convergence
asp$sdr$pdHess
## return: TRUE

##Morans I: Spatial Autocorrelation
asp$residuals <- as.vector(residuals(asp))
x <- data$Longitude
y <- data$Latitude
distMat <- as.matrix(dist(cbind(x,y)))
invDistMat <- 1/distMat  
diag(invDistMat) <- 0
moran <- Moran.I(asp$residuals, weight=invDistMat) ##Null hypothesis is there is no spatial autocorrelation
moran
##Spatial autocorrelation remains because p < 0.05; see ?Moran.I with respect to the null hypothesis

#------------Spatial zero-inflated​ glmmTMB() model-------------------
#Matern Model, following recommendations at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/glmmTMB/vignettes/covstruct.html
n <- nrow(data)
locs <- numFactor(subset$Longitude,subset$Latitude)
group <- factor(rep(1,n))
mod.mat0 <- glmmTMB(Tot_Lar ~ 1 + scale(NEAR_DIST, center=T, scale=T) + mat(locs + 0 | group), data=data, family=nbinom2(link="log"), ziformula =~1)

##Convergence error; see fixef(), following recommendations at https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/glmmTMB/vignettes/troubleshooting.html
fixef(mod.mat0)

Does anyone have any recommendations as to how to potentially fix the spatial model's convergence errors? Could it be a structural issue of, "mat(locs + 0 | group)," or something else? If someone could also expound on what the syntax "mat(locs + 0 | group)" represents in a glmmTMB() model with a Matern spatial variance-covariance structure that would be particularly helpful as well. 

Many thanks in advance. 

Cheers, 
April
